text:
rachel: Quick design check: I pushed a tiny tweak to the preflight network step — trying stronger contrast for de-emphasized "success" rows and clearer focus outlines. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ux123/preflight-contrast (frame: contrast-focus). Thoughts? :eyeglasses:
omar: Agree on stronger outlines. current dim text at 3:1 is unreadable on some monitors. bump to 4.5:1 for body text and keep 3:1 only for decorative icons.
lee: Also, keyboard users are losing the visible focus when rows are collapsed. we should show a 2px solid focus ring that doesn't rely on color alone. use a non-color indicator (dashed inner shadow or thicker border).
toni: Small copy tweak: row label "port ok" reads casual. style guide recommends sentence fragments: use "Port open" / "Port closed" / "DNS resolved". keep capitalization consistent.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder: ensure focus contrast meets 3:1 for rings and text contrast 4.5:1. Also add `aria-describedby` on focus for rows that have supplemental hints. See: https://internal.redwood.ai/a11y/preflight-summary
rachel: For collapsed-success mode I proposed a faint summary line: "5 hidden — expand to view". suggestion: make the number more prominent and the word "hidden" lower emphasis but still readable. maybe bold the count only.
omar: When collapsed, a persistent failure pill should still be first in DOM so screen readers find it immediately. treat that pill as `role=region` and `aria-live="polite"` for changes.
lee: Focus flow: when a user tabs into the step, focus lands on the summary banner. pressing Enter expands and moves focus to the first failure. Escape collapses back and returns focus to banner. needs explicit spec for devs.
toni: Microcopy for toasts: instead of "Probe retried" use "Retry started" so ephemeral status is clearer. also make copy confirmations short: "Copied 3 probes" not sentences.
a11y-bot: Tooltip guidance: all probe tooltips must be reachable via keyboard (tab) and have `role="tooltip"` + `aria-hidden` toggling. avoid hover-only interactions.
figma-bot: New figma version uploaded by rachel at 2026-03-24T09:10:12Z.
rachel: I'll update the mock with examples: 2 hosts (no collapse), 6 hosts (auto-collapse), 18 hosts (group badges). I'll add overlay demonstrating the focus ring and aria notes. tagging @omar @lee @toni for final review. :sparkles:
